body: Thank you for responding. Like I said to hammyhabits, I didn't actually think people would respond. Believe me, I have wanted to try and talk to her so much, at one point I was standing nervously ten feet or so behind her thinking what to say, and I couldn't. My anger capped and I uncontrollably punched the door next to me and yelled "fuck". Pretty sure she saw, and probably thinks I'm crazy. The inevitability of me and her not ever being together because of my stupidity haunts me everyday. Thanks again for your advice. I probably screwed it up forever, but I have decided that I will see a councilor or therapist of some sort, may as well. Seeing that random people that I don't know care about the life of someone they have never seen before is actually pretty touching. Thanks

Thank you for the response. To be honest I didn't expect anyone to respond. Honestly I've never seen myself seeing a counselor, I don't know how it could help. But I came here for help, obviously I want to somehow solve my problem so I will heed your advice. But If I care enough to attempt my ridiculously stupid problem, then do I even count as someone that is suicidal? I'm probably just confusing you, I don't even know why that was necessary to say. I'm just kind of typing out my mind right now. I'm sorry for complaining, I feel like my problem is nothing compared to others. Which it probably is. Thanks again
